messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off CONFIG-ONLY deploy to CANARY (split routing). applying small routing + batch/timeout changes. change-window=2026-03-20T22:00Z..2026-03-20T23:30Z. release-notes: https://go/relnotes/softsplice-canary 

maria: heads-up — configs: 
```
route_policy: split
split_weights: { canary: 0.10, stable: 0.90 }
batching:
  max_requests: 8
  max_concurrency: 16
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 2000
  kv_cache_ttl_ms: 60000
limits:
  tenant_floor: 0.05
```

liam: noted. I'll watch metrics (p99 latency, error rate, tail qps). tagging oncall.

sasha: can we also set soft-fallback to model:v2.1-quant if canary latency spikes? add fallback policy now so deploy bot can attach: `fallback_model: v2.1-quant`

deploy-bot: applied config diff to canary pool (pool-id: canary-alpha). observed lightweight rollout: 10% traffic to canary. starting health checks.

maria: quick sanity check command i ran: `curl -H "X-Tenant: test-team" https://api.redwood.internal/gen?model=service-default` returned 200 and stream ok.

anna: product note — this is config-only; no model binaries. purpose: reduce cost on low-variance workloads. watch for any change in token-generation time for midpoint prompts.

ben: watching infra dashboards. hooking up a short alert on p95 > 700ms or error-rate > 0.5% for the canary. will call if thresholds trip.

liam: deploy-bot just posted health: `canary-alpha: 120/120 checks passing; p50=70ms p95=180ms p99=340ms`

sasha: good numbers. can we limit batch.max_requests to 6 instead of 8 for this canary? reduces tail in some tenants.

maria: +1 for reducing to 6. but keep max_concurrency=16 so overall throughput not hurt.

deploy-bot: updating canary config: `batching.max_requests=6` (diff applied). rebalancing in progress.

alex: FYI I pinned model routing for the canary at `model_tag: v2.1-rc3` to keep outputs stable while we tweak batching.

liam: quick run of the smoke set (10 prompts): all outputs match baseline tolerances. latency slightly better with max_requests=6.

ben: alert fired briefly at 22:07 but it was a spurious spike from a tenant flood; cleared automatically. no action needed.

sasha: still want fallback in place though — if p99 > 800ms for 2m straight we should route to `v2.1-quant` automatically. can we add that to the rollout policy?

deploy-bot: added policy: `if p99_ms(canary) > 800 for 120s -> shift 100% canary traffic to fallback_model=v2.1-quant and notify #incidents`.

maria: can we capture this change in the release notes? small blurb + link to config diff. i'll draft.

anna: SG. also add a line about the change-window and the tenant_floor tweak (helps prepaid customers).

liam: monitoring at 22:30 — metrics stable. p95 below 200ms.

ben: rolling to 25% for an extra verification step? prefer gradual increase: 10% -> 25% wait 15m -> 50% if stable.

sasha: agree. please run canary for 15m at 10% then 25%. don't push to 50% until we review the 25% telemetry.

deploy-bot: failed attempt to increase to 25% due to quota guard on canary pool (quota_error). reverting to 10%.

maria: thanks for the revert. who owns the quota guard? @ben can you take a look?

ben: checking now — quota guard was intentionally low to prevent noisy tenant bursts. i'll temporarily raise it for the next 30m, then revert.

ben: quota bump applied. attempting 25% now.

deploy-bot: updated split_weights: { canary: 0.25, stable: 0.75 }. running health checks.

liam: 5m into 25% — p99=360ms, errors steady. no anomalies.

sasha: ran a targeted regen load test against canary tenants; CPU looks fine, kv cache hit-rate steady.

maria: thumbs up from me. proceed to 50% after 15m if no regression. leaving small note in release notes: "reduced batching window to 6 to lower tail latency; added automated fallback to quantized model at p99>800ms; tenant floor adjusted."

deploy-bot: at 22:55 canary at 50% (split applied). final validation running.

liam: final smoke set at 50% OK. marking canary PASS.

anna: approved to promote. please add a short follow-up in #product-release when fully rolled.

maria: I'll publish the release note + changelog link and set a calendar reminder to unpin the canary-specific routing in 24h if stable.

ben: will revert quota guard back down at 23:40 as planned.

deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY deploy COMPLETE: canary promoted and split removed; cluster now using updated batching/timeout/limits across target pools. links: config-diff: https://go/config/diff/1759999998 ; metrics-snapshot: https://go/metrics/snap/1759999998

alex: nice job team. no rollback needed. closing thread. :tada:
